title: "It’s fine!" (it was not fine.)
caption: Every "it's fine" gets saved somewhere, until the folder is full. Libra said "love that for us!" about the dishes. Small honest no's on the day it happens keep love from cracking. A disagreement isn't a breakup. Who says "it's fine" too much?
